title: Senior System Software Engineer – Accelerated Microservices and Libraries
description:
We are looking for a senior software engineer to contribute to building accelerated microservices and libraries for our harnesses and agents. In this role, you will be part of an engineering team designing and developing microservices and libraries and optimizing these for relevant metrics. 
 
What you will be doing: 
- Contribute to design and development of accelerated microservices and libraries 
- Collaborate with peer engineering and Product Management teams to understand requirements and translate these into deliverables across milestones. 
- Design, develop, and maintain real-time vision-language model inference microservices, from video ingestion and preprocessing through model serving and downstream integration. 
- Develop automated functional, accuracy, and performance regression tests, and own component readiness through integration, release, and post-release debugging. 
- Profile and optimize end-to-end latency, throughput, GPU memory usage, and concurrent user capacity across platforms. 
 
What we need to see: 
- Masters or Bachelors degree in Computer Science, or related engineering field 
- 8+ years of overall experience in software development , a strong technical foundation in software design principles and strong programming skills in C/C++ and Python. 
- Hands-on experience building microservices using containers, REST APIs, and asynchronous messaging. 
- Hands-on experience integrating and serving computer vision and vision-language models in production. 
- Understanding of real-time video processing and the tradeoffs among latency, throughput, and resource utilization and strong debugging skills. 
- Experience evaluating model quality and diagnosing accuracy or performance regressions across model, preprocessing, and inference-runtime changes. 
 
Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
- Experience delivering end-to-end video AI applications, including video ingestion, inference, tracking, analytics, and downstream integrations, using technologies such as RTSP and FFmpeg. 
- Background with NVIDIA DeepStream, TensorRT, Triton Inference Server, CUDA, or comparable technologies. 
- Experience optimizing and profiling GPU inference pipelines, including batching, memory management, and concurrent model execution. 
- Experience with stateful streaming inference, KV-cache management, batching, quantization, and their impact on serving performance. 
- Experience profiling GPU applications with tools such as NVIDIA Nsight Systems and deploying inference services across x86 and ARM platforms. 

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and passionate people in the world working for us. Are you a creative problem solver with a passion for solving real-world problems with AI? If so, we want to hear from you.

title: Lead Engineer
description:
Who We Are
At Maersk, we are modernising our SAP landscape to deliver secure, scalable, resilient, and intelligent business solutions. As part of this transformation, we are strengthening our SAP engineering capabilities across S/4HANA, ABAP, SAP BTP, integrations, cloud technologies, and AI-enabled development.
We are looking for an experienced Lead Engineer – SAP ABAP & Solution Architecture who can combine deep SAP technical expertise with strong architecture and engineering leadership to help shape our future SAP ecosystem.
The Position
As a Lead Engineer – SAP ABAP & Solution Architecture, you will provide technical leadership across SAP application development and solution architecture.
You will design scalable SAP solutions, guide ABAP engineering standards, support S/4HANA transformation, and work closely with functional, integration, platform, security, and product teams.
The role requires a strong hands-on understanding of ABAP/ABAP OO, S/4HANA, CDS Views, OData, APIs, integrations, SAP BTP, Fiori and modern SAP development practices.
You will also help drive adoption of AI-assisted engineering, automation, clean-core principles, and modern development practices across the SAP landscape.

Key Responsibilities
SAP Architecture & Solution Design
- Lead technical architecture and solution design across SAP applications and integrations.
- Translate business and functional requirements into scalable SAP technical solutions.
- Define architecture standards and technical design principles for S/4HANA and associated SAP platforms.
- Drive clean-core principles, reducing unnecessary customisation and promoting extensions using appropriate SAP technologies.
- Review solution designs and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, security, performance and integration standards.
- Provide technical direction for complex SAP transformation and modernisation initiatives.

SAP ABAP Engineering
- Lead development and engineering across ABAP, ABAP Objects, CDS Views, AMDP, RFC/BAPI, IDoc, OData and APIs.
- Drive high-quality development standards covering performance, scalability, maintainability, security and reusability.
- Guide technical design, code reviews, troubleshooting and performance optimisation.
- Support custom-code remediation and modernisation as part of ECC-to-S/4HANA transformation.
- Promote reusable frameworks, engineering standards and development best practices.
- Provide guidance on enhancements, interfaces, conversions, workflows, forms and application extensions.
 
AI-Enabled SAP Engineering
- Drive adoption of AI and Generative AI capabilities within the SAP engineering lifecycle.
- Explore the use of tools such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot and enterprise AI platforms to improve developer productivity.
- Identify opportunities for AI-assisted code development, documentation, testing, troubleshooting and technical analysis.
- Ensure AI technologies are adopted responsibly and in accordance with enterprise security and governance requirements.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration
- Provide technical leadership and mentoring to SAP engineers and developers.
- Establish architecture, development and code-quality standards.
- Conduct architecture reviews, technical design reviews and engineering governance.
- Collaborate closely with SAP Functional, Basis, Integration, Security, Cloud, Data and Product teams.
- Engage with business and technology stakeholders to translate complex requirements into practical technical solutions.
- Support major SAP transformation programmes and influence technology decisions across the SAP landscape.

Our Ideal Candidate
- Deep technical experience in SAP ABAP and SAP solution architecture.
- Strong hands-on knowledge of ABAP Objects, CDS Views, OData, APIs and modern S/4HANA development approaches.
- Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA architecture and transformation.
- Experience designing enterprise-scale solutions across multiple SAP modules and integrated systems.
- Understanding of SAP BTP, Fiori and modern SAP extension approaches.
- Experience with SAP integration patterns and technologies.
- Strong understanding of clean-core architecture and reducing unnecessary SAP customisation.
- Experience with CI/CD, automation and modern engineering practices.
- Exposure to AI/Generative AI-enabled software engineering practices is desirable.
- Strong technical leadership and stakeholder management capabilities.
- Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear recommendations for technical and business stakeholders.
 
Required Skills & Experience
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related field.
- 12–18 years of SAP technical experience, with substantial experience in ABAP engineering and SAP technical/solution architecture.
- Expert-level knowledge of SAP ABAP, ABAP Objects and S/4HANA development.
- Strong experience with CDS Views, OData, APIs, RFC/BAPI, IDocs and SAP integration patterns.
- Experience with modern SAP development technologies such as RAP, Fiori and SAP BTP.
- Demonstrated experience designing solutions for large-scale SAP ECC and/or S/4HANA environments.
- Strong experience with ECC-to-S/4HANA transformation, custom-code remediation and application modernisation.
- Understanding of SAP security, authorisation, performance and development governance.
- Experience with Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD and automated deployment/testing practices is desirable.
- Experience integrating SAP with cloud, SaaS and enterprise applications.
- Exposure to AI/Generative AI tools for software engineering is an advantage.
- Strong problem-solving, architecture, communication and stakeholder-management skills.
- Experience leading technical teams and influencing architecture decisions across complex enterprise environments.

title: Sr Software Engineer
description:
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
Join us to put AI to work for people.

About the Team
The engineering organization is a dynamic group of builders, thinkers, and problem-solvers dedicated to delivering scalable, AI-powered software products that elevate how organizations work. We value clean architecture, intuitive user experiences, and a culture of continuous improvement. Every engineer here plays a key role in shaping the quality and reliability of our products.
What you get to do in this role:
- Design and develop scalable, maintainable, and reusable software components with a strong emphasis on performance and reliability.
- Collaborate with product managers to translate requirements into well-architected solutions, owning features from design through delivery
- Build intuitive and extensible user experiences using modern UI frameworks, ensuring flexibility for customer-specific needs.
- Contribute to the design and implementation of new products and features while enhancing existing product capabilities.
- Integrate automated testing into development workflows to ensure consistent quality across releases.
- Participate in design and code reviews ensuring best practices in performance, maintainability, and testability.
- Develop comprehensive test strategies covering functional, regression, integration and performance aspects
- Foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement by sharing best practices in engineering and quality
- Promote a culture of engineering craftsmanship, knowledge-sharing, and thoughtful quality practices across the team.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:
- Experience in leveraging critical thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry.
- 5+ years of experience in software engineering, with a track record of delivering high-quality products.
- Proficiency in Python, Java, Javascript or other object-oriented languages.
- Experience with modern front-end frameworks such as Angular, React, or Vue.
- Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, design patterns, and performance optimization
- Familiarity with automated testing frameworks (e.g., JUnit, Selenium, TestNG) and integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines
- Understanding software quality principles including reliability, observability, and production readiness.
- Ability to troubleshoot complex systems and optimize performance across the stack.
- Experience with AI-powered tools or workflows, including validation of datasets, model predictions, and inference consistency.
- Comfort with development tools such as IDEs, debuggers, profilers, source control, and Unix-based systems
Why Join Us
- Build and deliver high-impact software that powers digital experiences for millions of users.
- Collaborate in a culture that values craftsmanship, quality, and innovation.
- Work symbiotically with AI and automation tools that enhance engineering excellence and drive product reliability.
- Be part of a culture that encourages innovation, continuous learning, and shared success.

Work Personas

title: Software Engineer III
description:

The Financial Crime and Risk Management (FCRM) team within Enterprise Technology Services (ETS) at American Express is building the next generation of AI-enabled, world-class capabilities to support second-line risk and compliance functions and financial crime investigation teams.
We are looking for a highly motivated Engineer III with hands-on experience in NICE Actimize Suspicious Activity Monitoring (SAM) to help develop, enhance, and support our AML transaction monitoring platform. This role will contribute to delivering scalable, reliable, and high-performance solutions supporting Anti-Money Laundering (AML) monitoring and regulatory compliance initiatives across the company.
The ideal candidate will bring strong technical skills in Actimize SAM development, SQL, data integration, and application troubleshooting, along with the ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, product, and compliance teams. This position offers opportunities to contribute to platform modernization, automation, and the continued evolution of our enterprise AML transaction monitoring capabilities.

- Design, develop, configure, test, deploy, and support NICE Actimize SAM solutions to meet AML transaction monitoring and business requirements.
- Develop, enhance, and maintain Actimize SAM detection scenarios, monitoring rules, thresholds, and configurations.
- Work with Actimize SAM components, including Actimize Intelligence Server (AIS), data processing workflows, and supporting application infrastructure.
- Develop and maintain data ingestion, transformation, and processing pipelines supporting transaction monitoring within the Actimize SAM platform.
- Collaborate with Product, Compliance, Risk, and Engineering teams to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
- Participate as a core member of an Agile engineering team, contributing to user story analysis, technical design, development, testing, and deployment activities.
- Develop and maintain integrations between Actimize SAM and enterprise data sources, databases, and downstream systems.

- Support Actimize SAM platform enhancements, upgrades, and maintenance activities.
- Contribute to automation of application deployment, testing, monitoring, and operational support processes.
- Troubleshoot and resolve application issues related to scenario execution, transaction processing, data quality, and batch processing.
- Collaborate with senior engineers and architects to implement scalable, secure, and reliable technical solutions.
- Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing activities to promote engineering best practices.
- Develop and maintain technical documentation, including design specifications, processing flows, and operational procedures.
- Contribute to improving platform reliability, performance, observability, and operational efficiency.

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
- 4+ years of experience in software engineering or enterprise application development, including hands-on experience with NICE Actimize SAM (Suspicious Activity Monitoring).
- Practical experience in Actimize SAM development, configuration, customization, testing, or production support.
- Experience working with Actimize SAM detection scenarios, monitoring rules, thresholds, and transaction processing workflows.
- Working knowledge of Actimize Intelligence Server (AIS) and SAM application architecture.
- Strong SQL skills, including writing complex queries, stored procedures, and troubleshooting database-related issues.
- Experience with relational databases such as Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, or PostgreSQL.
- Experience with data integration, ETL processes, data mapping, and data validation.
- Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language, such as Java or Python.
- Understanding of AML transaction monitoring concepts and the role of detection scenarios in identifying potentially suspicious activity.
- Experience troubleshooting application issues, batch processing failures, and data integration problems.
- Familiarity with software development lifecycle practices, Agile methodologies, version control, and automated testing.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
- Ability to independently deliver assigned development tasks and work effectively with cross-functional teams.
Preferred:
- Experience implementing or enhancing NICE Actimize SAM solutions in a financial services environment.
- Familiarity with Actimize Intelligence Server (AIS), SAM data models, and scenario execution processes.
- Experience supporting production AML transaction monitoring applications and troubleshooting performance or processing issues.
- Experience with Actimize SAM platform upgrades, configuration changes, or application enhancements.
- Knowledge of AML regulatory requirements, including BSA/AML, KYC, Customer Due Diligence (CDD), and Suspicious Activity Reporting (SAR).
- Experience with SQL query optimization, database performance tuning, and large-scale batch data processing.
- Exposure to cloud technologies, particularly Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, automated testing, and application monitoring tools.
- Experience with APIs, web services, and enterprise application integration patterns.
- Understanding of data governance, data quality, and regulatory data management practices.
- Interest in platform modernization, automation, and AI/ML-enabled AML transaction monitoring capabilities.
- Demonstrated willingness to learn new technologies, improve engineering practices, and contribute to team success.

description:

At OpenGov bold ideas ship daily and rapid iteration turns directly into measurable customer impact. We stay relentlessly aligned with customer outcomes while pushing the frontier of AI-driven software development, using cutting-edge AI tools and techniques to build systems that scale.

WHY OPENGOV?



A Mission That Matters. 

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust.  Some people say this is boring.  We think it’s the core of our democracy.

A Team of Passionate, Driven People

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.

title: Software Engineer (L3)
description:
Who we are

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. 
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as our next Senior Software engineer (L3) on Twilio’s Segment, Data platform/ pipelines team.

About the job

This position is needed to build new features and capabilities in the Twilio Segment Data platform/ pipelines team.

As a Senior Software Engineer on this team, you’ll build and scale systems that process several hundred thousands of data points per second. Helping our customers unlock value of their data from external systems and activate it to various destinations via Segment capabilities. You will work on high-scale ingestion and data processing systems. 

We iterate quickly on these products and features and learn new things daily — all while writing quality code. We work closely with product and design and solve some of the toughest engineering problems to unlock new possibilities for our customers. If you get excited by building products with high customer impact — this is the place for you.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

- Design and deliver robust, high-scale routing experiences for Data Pipelines for Twilio Segment.

- Operate always-available, complex distributed systems in cloud environments.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with design, product, and other engineers to define solutions that balance usability, performance, and long-term architecture.

- Communicate technical decisions clearly - articulating trade-offs, customer impact, and team alignment.

- Mentor junior engineers and contribute to a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning.

- Participate in an on-call rotation for our managed services. Troubleshoot and improve system reliability, debugging issues and refining operational tooling and processes.

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

- Hands-on experience with high-scale messaging/streaming systems and processing engines (several thousand events/sec). 

- 5-7 years experience writing production-grade code in a modern programming language.

- Proficient programming experience in Go, Java, Python or similar object-oriented languages.

- Experience operating large-scale, distributed systems on top of cloud infrastructure.

- Experience shipping services (products) following CI/CD development paradigm.

- Good grasp of software engineering and how to build a system in scalable and extensive manner;

- Leverage best-in-class development productivity practices including AI tooling.

- Excellent communication, problem-solving, and operational excellence skills

Desired:

- Have hands-on experience with container orchestration frameworks (e.g. Kubernetes, EKS, ECS)

- Technical depth in distributed systems, high-scale ingestion, and cloud-native architecture.

- Proficiency with datastores, distributed caching, and container technologies (Docker/Kubernetes). 

- Experience with modern CI/CD pipelines and observability tools (Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus).

- Familiarity with AI/ML technologies.

- Excellent abilities in high level service design -- modeling interfaces and internals in a properly modular, composable, and extensible way.

- Experience working in a geographically distributed team. 

Location

 This role will be based in any of the permitted 5 India states (Delhi, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Telangana & TamilNadu)

Travel 

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.
Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
description:
Strength in Trust 

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society. 

The Challenge

- As Senior Staff Software Engineer develop strategic methods and principles to improve the technical stability and efficiency of the company's products/services.

- You lead and influence several teams and initiatives.

Your Mission

- Has deep knowledge of entire system and can jump into code in any component and fire fight and contribute. Makes decisions on product direction and internals based on deep subject matter knowledge.

- Sets product direction and has ownership over large components. Thinks both strategically and tactically, keeping in mind both technical goals and company goals.

- Given long term strategic goals, can lay out a path across many versions. Participates in and supports initiatives outside of main area of responsibility. Provides technical leadership for projects including 3–4 individuals.

- Builds strong relationships in their own team and across the company. Understands multiple points of view and drives a process to conclusions in a timely and respectful manner.

- Mentor others with high-level technical guidance. Improve the company’s technical prowess. Put customers first and set strategic short-term targets. Take up open-ended problems.

- Designing, coding, and debugging software.

- Improving the performance of existing software.

- Providing training to other engineers.

- Maintaining and upgrading existing software.

- Recommending new technologies that can help increase productivity.

- Supervising and overseeing the technical aspects of projects.

- Investigating software-related complaints and making necessary adjustments to ensure optimal software performance.

- Regularly attending team meetings to discuss projects, brainstorm ideas, and put forward solutions to any issues.

- Work with testing team to develop performance test plans and cases.

- Research and collect product information and support the development of specifications and requirements for consideration.

You Are

- High technical and/or technological competence

- Strong documentation, analytical and problem-solving skills

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field 

- Minimum of 10+ years of hands-on experience with Java based development projects using RESTful APIs, SpringBoot, Micro services.

- Strong analytical skills.

- Good communication skills.

- Excellent organizational and leadership skills

- Proven experience in high-level programming languages, like Java.

- Proven experience in software development methodologies.

- Proven experience building complex web systems.

Extra Awesome

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical or business field

- Expertise with running web services at scale.

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.

Resources 

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people: 

- OneTrust Careers on YouTube

- @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview. You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.

description:

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

Join the team as our next Staff engineer (L4) on Twilio’s Segment, Data Pipelines team.

As a Staff Engineer on the Twilio Segment Data platform/ pipelines team, you’ll build and scale systems that process several hundred thousands of data points per second. You will lead the development of high-scale ingestion and data processing systems You'll be designing, operating and maintaining complex distributed systems, ensuring reliability, performance, and cost-efficiency while querying petabytes of data for our customer data platform (CDP).

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

title: Sr. Staff Software Development Engineer - Automation
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

This unique and challenging position bridges software design engineering and test engineering to design, develop, and deploy wide-reaching tools and frameworks that automatically verify product quality at scale.

services, and data workflows

- Design and deliver effective, automatable test plans with strong coverage for functional, regression, and system
integration scenarios

- Build and maintain UI and API automation using modern frameworks to ensure stability, maintainability, and fast
feedback

- Validate large-scale systems including REST APIs, backend services, distributed workflows, and microservices

- You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

- Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

- Advanced proficiency in automation testing using Python (pytest/unittest), JavaScript, or TypeScript

- Hands-on experience with UI automation tools such as Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright for end-to-end validation

- Deep experience testing distributed systems, microservices, and scalable cloud-native multi-tenant architectures in AWS, GCP, or Azure environments

- Solid understanding of CI/CD integration, Linux troubleshooting, and containerized environments including Docker and Kubernetes

- Technical knowledge of L2/L3 networking concepts, including routing protocols, VPN, IPSec, and WAN architecture

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

- Proven experience designing scalable test frameworks covering architecture, patterns, reporting, stability, and parallelization
Proficiency with Git, test management tools like TestRail, and issue tracking systems such as Jira

- Hands-on experience with AI agent prompting and usage for productivity, test design, and automation support

description:

This role is a good fit for an engineer who enjoys building reliable, secure, and performant enterprise software, working across application layers, and solving customer problems with a collaborative team. • Experience developing software with Java 11+ and the Spring Framework.
 Working knowledge of

- JavaScript

- jQuery

- Angular (Nova Framework)

- SQL, and the Tomcat Application Server.

• Ability to contribute to features across frontend and backend layers, with support from the team as appropriate.
• Familiarity with software development fundamentals, including debugging, testing, code review, and source control.
• Exposure to DevOps practices and continuous integration/deployment is a plus.
• Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants or agents in software development is preferred; curiosity and willingness to learn are important.
• Familiarity with spec-driven development—or experience working from written requirements, technical specifications, and acceptance criteria—is preferred.
• Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, product partners, and other stakeholders.

title: Staff Software Engineer- Databricks AI
description:
At Databricks, we are passionate about helping enterprises that build ML models and AI agents deliver high-quality AI to production fast. Founded by engineers, and customer obsessed, we leap at every opportunity to tackle technical challenges, from designing great developer experiences to building reliable systems at global scale. And we're only getting started.

Our team builds the MLOps and LLMOps platform that millions of AI developers and ML practitioners use to track model training experiments, manage model registry, observe and evaluate AI agents. We're the team behind MLflow, the most widely adopted open-source AI engineering platform with more than 30 million package downloads per month, and its managed service used by thousands of organizations globally. We're now expanding to Bengaluru, India, and building our first AI engineering team there from scratch to work on this platform.

As a Staff Software Engineer and a founding member of the Bengaluru team, you'll be the team's technical lead. You'll set the platform strategy and architecture, drive alignment with partner teams, and lead the team to deliver a world-class MLOps and LLMOps platform, while staying hands-on.

Check out our recent blog post: coSTAR: How we ship AI agents at Databricks fast, without breaking things

The impact you will have:

- Define the platform strategy and long-term architecture.

- Lead engineering efforts from design to production rollout, with high standards for performance, correctness, and reliability.

- Solve hard problems in ingesting and querying traces, metrics, and artifacts at scale, and in evaluating AI agents in production.

- Align product, research, and engineering teams across sites on technical direction and trade-offs.

- Shape APIs and developer experiences that make it easy for customers to ship AI.

- Mentor senior engineers through design reviews and technical discussions.

- Represent the team externally through blog posts, talks, and open-source contributions to popular AI frameworks.

What we look for:

- BS (or higher) in Computer Science, or a related field.

- 10+ years of experience developing large-scale distributed systems, scaling infrastructure, or building platforms and developer tools for other teams.

- Strong foundation in algorithms, data structures, and system design.

- Strong experience with backend technical stacks such as Scala or Java.

- Experience with cloud technologies, e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes.

- Engineering maturity in security, correctness, and operational excellence.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Who Are We?

Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.

The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman.

P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.

The Opportunity

You will be part of Postman’s Test Infrastructure team, which powers quality at scale across the company.

At Postman, we believe that quality is everyone’s responsibility. Our team builds the systems, tooling, and infrastructure that enable developers to ship reliable, high-quality products efficiently. From CI/CD pipelines to test frameworks and observability, we focus on improving developer productivity and accelerating feedback loops.

We’re looking for a senior engineer who can help us scale our test infrastructure to meet the next phase of Postman’s growth.

What You’ll Do
- Design and build scalable test infrastructure, frameworks, and tooling with a strong engineering-first mindset
Collaborate with a small, high-impact team to improve system reliability and developer productivity
Own and evolve CI/CD pipelines to optimise performance, cost, and feedback cycles
Develop internal tools and frameworks that simplify testing and improve product quality
Build and enhance test observability systems, including metrics, dashboards, and insights
Drive improvements in test performance, stability, and execution efficiency
Champion best practices in testing, reliability, and developer experience across teams
Continuously explore and introduce new tools, technologies, and methodologies
About You
- 2 to 5 years of experience building large-scale JavaScript/TypeScript applications
Strong fundamentals in software design, systems thinking, and test infrastructure
Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks and CI/CD systems
Experience building or working with test observability, analytics, or reporting systems
Proven track record of owning and delivering complex engineering initiatives
Comfortable working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
Strong communication skills and the ability to influence engineering practices

What Else?

In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves. 

At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.

Our Values

At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can.

Equal Opportunity

Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Postman will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.

Technical Data Management (TDM) and Product Data Management (PDM) form the digital backbone of Airbus engineering. They enable engineering design data—along with its metadata, configuration, and release workflows—to be enriched, structured, and viewed in digital form for release to manufacturing and downstream customers.
As the Business Release Manager (BRM) – TDM / PDM, you will operate within an emerging Agile SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) environment. You will lead the end-to-end business deployment, change management, business acceptance testing, and early life support for TDM/PDM tools across in-service, under-development, and future aircraft programs. This role bridges the gap between Digital/IT teams, Program Management and Extended Enterprise (Suppliers).
Main Activities: 
- Release Management & Roadmap Alignment- Track and manage the deployment of Epics, Capabilities, and features, utilizing VersionOne as the primary system of record.
- Partner with Solution/Product Managers and Epic Owners to define and establish release and solution roadmaps.
- Synchronize release roadmaps (including MVP0) with Programs and MCA through Blue/Orange plan alignment.
- Engage actively in Pre- and Post-PI planning sessions to ensure seamless continuity across release cycles.
- Map Large Solution dependencies and conduct regular alignment sessions with release managers to harmonize deployment strategies across PI plannings.

- Deployment Execution, Governance & Enablement- Design robust deployment strategies and detailed execution plans covering training, communication, user documentation and methodology.
- Steer end-to-end business rollout across external suppliers for PDM and TDM releases.
- Supervise the development, review, and approval of user training materials.
- Lead Go/No-Go decision gates with key stakeholders from Programs, DDMS, MCA, LS, and Procurement.
- Ensure that TDM and PDM solutions comply with Export Control, GDPR, IP protection, Extended Enterprise (EE), and data segregation standards.

● Post-Deployment & Operational Continuity
- Direct post-deployment operational phases and Early Life Support (ELS) in coordination with the Business Operation Support (BOS) and Elbow support teams.
- Maintain, update, and present quarterly PDM/TDM Airframe M&T roadmaps to key client stakeholders.
- Financial & Business Governance- Lead effort estimation, budget planning, financial management, supplier coordination, and business case value realization in partnership with customers.
- Coordinate and deliver PDM/TDM business requirements and inputs into Digital Team workstreams.

Business Acceptance Testing (BAT) Management.
● Lead and manage Business Testing of TDM/PDM solutions 
○ Define BAT strategy (Business Acceptance Test), Test Scenarios, Test cases, Test scripts, feature/capability coverage matrix, data flow diagrams and test data specifications 
○ Prepare Business Test strategy. 
○ Identify, plan and manage Business Testers (along with their budget expectations) including suppliers if relevant as agreed with Program, Project & Procurement. 
○ Prepare and Manage the Business Test Campaign. 
○ Lead Business Test Executions and Defect Management - Organize and drive daily defect drum beats.
○ Manage conclusion of Business Testing and get sign off from key stakeholders. Skills: 
● Understanding and experience with Agile methodologies. 
● Extensive knowledge and experience in one of the following engineering toolsets 
○ PDM/TDM tools (e.g. 3D Experience, Catia V5, VPM, PASS SSI, APS, DPDS, TAKSY, GILDA, SPRINT NG,VPM etc.) 
● Configuration Management principles.
● Experience working on different Project Management methodologies like 
Waterfall/Agile/DevOps preferred. 
● Knowledge of PM&T documentations, DE.PA referential (Instructions, Procedures, PSD’s etc.) preferred.

Qualification: 
B.E / M.E / M. Tech / Mechanical / Aeronautical 

Experience: 
Preferably 8-12 years of relevant experience 

Soft skills: 
● Strong Project Management skills 
● Autonomous, Self-empowered and Team Player 
● Creative thinker 
● Strategic thinking 
● Comfortable in a multicultural team, employing ethical leadership with cross cultural and diverse viewpoints 
● Proficient oral and written communication skills, flexible, engaged and curious. ● Ability to develop leadership skills by identifying development needs. 
● Willingness to take more responsibility and ownership on the involved topics.
 ● Capability to challenge, adopt and to collaborate with transnational multidisciplinary teams. 
● Management of stakeholders and their expectation 
● Interpersonal skills and developing relationships with team members and customers ● Outstanding communication, presentation and leadership skills

title: Software Developer 2
description:
#RunwiththePack

At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to end cyber risk. 

We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity. 

More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference. 

We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level. 
 
About the Position:
Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a Software Developer 2, to be part of making that happen.

Position Overview and Objective

The Software Developer 2 supports Arctic Wolf’s Engineering organization by helping ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of Aurora Endpoint Security and our cloud-based services. This person partners closely with Engineering and Product teams to drive test automation, improve release confidence, and strengthen engineering productivity through modern quality engineering and AI-assisted development practices.

As a Developer 2, Quality Engineering at Arctic Wolf, you will:

What You’ll Do
- Design, build, and maintain a Python-based automation framework that validates product functionality, reliability, and quality across Windows, macOS, and Linux environments
- Develop and grow a Pytest-based test infrastructure as the core of the automation framework, writing clean, reusable, and maintainable Python code
- Build automation for product deployment, upgrade, and validation workflows, using Python as the primary language and Ansible and Terraform to support infrastructure and configuration tasks
- Write Python-based CLI tools and endpoint validation scenarios that extend the framework’s coverage and usability across platforms
- Use AI-powered engineering tools to speed up framework design, automation development, and debugging
- Work closely with engineering, product management, and cross-functional teams to identify quality risks, refine requirements, and ensure the framework delivers comprehensive test coverage throughout the software development life cycle
- Investigate, troubleshoot, document, and track product defects, partnering with teammates to drive timely resolution and root cause analysis
- Contribute to the ongoing evolution of the automation framework, improving product quality, test coverage, and release confidence over time
What We’re Looking For
- 2-5 years of professional automation development experience, with real framework-building work, not just script writing
- Strong Python skills, with hands-on experience designing automation frameworks, Pytest-based test suites, CLI tools, and endpoint validation scenarios
- Comfort building and running automation across Windows, macOS, and Linux, with an understanding of how platform differences affect framework design
- Experience designing, developing, and maintaining automation solutions that improve product quality, reliability, and engineering efficiency
- Working knowledge of AWS, including EC2 launch types, S3, CloudWatch logs, metrics, and alarms, and IAM roles, policies, and security controls
- Familiarity with Microsoft Azure services and cloud infrastructure
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar tools
- Familiarity with Docker-based development and build environments
- Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to perform effective root cause analysis and drive issues to resolution
Nice to Have
- Ansible for fleet configuration and provisioning
- Exposure to cybersecurity products, distributed systems, or SaaS platforms
- Experience with databases and SQL queries, or Bazel
- Experience with VMware, Hyper-V, or AWS or Azure infrastructure
 
Benefits

All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including: 

- Equity for all employees 
- 18 days annual leave, flexible holidays & festivals, and paid volunteer days 
- Training and career development programs 
- Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance. 
- A modern workplace in Helios Business Park in Bengaluru
 
Security Requirements  
 
At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business, customer, employee, and other confidential information and to support compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
 
Depending on the role and where permitted by applicable law, employment may be subject to background verification and additional regulatory, security, or compliance requirements, including obligations related to data protection and export control laws, and authorization requirements where applicable.

Your next big opportunity starts here — apply today and help us end cyber risk.

title: Lead Engineer - Systems Engineer
description:
Job Description Summary
We are seeking an experienced Lead Electrical Systems Engineer to lead the design, development, architecture, integration, verification and lifecycle support of complex electronic products and subsystems. The role requires strong hands-on expertise in mixed-signal electronics, embedded processing, power and battery systems, wireless technologies, communication interfaces, PCB development, EMC/EMI, reliability and electrical safety, combined with strong Systems Engineering thinking and product-level problem solving.
The successful candidate will drive engineering deliverables across NPI, Installed Base, VCP, component obsolescence, compliance and advanced technology development, while collaborating with Systems, Software/Firmware, Mechanical, Manufacturing, Sourcing, Quality, Service and suppliers. The role requires strong capability in system integration, wireless development and debugging, root-cause analysis and technical leadership, with opportunities to contribute to system architecture, platform development, reusable solutions and AI-enabled engineering transformation.

Job Description
 Roles & Responsibilities
- Lead electrical hardware development end-to-end, from requirements and architecture through detailed design, prototyping, verification, qualification, production release and lifecycle support.
- Translate system and product requirements into electrical requirements, architectures, interfaces and design specifications, ensuring effective requirements flow-down, traceability and verification.
- Design and technically review complex electronic hardware, including mixed-signal, analogue, embedded digital, processor/SoC, power, battery/charging, communication and high-speed interface circuits, including component selection, schematic design and PCB development.
- Lead system-level engineering trade-offs across performance, EMC/EMI, signal and power integrity, thermal performance, safety, reliability, manufacturability, testability, serviceability and cost, with proactive identification and mitigation of technical risks.
- Lead hardware integration, board bring-up, debugging, characterisation and verification, applying structured root-cause analysis to resolve complex board, subsystem and product-level technical issues.
- Lead wireless hardware design, development and integration for technologies such as Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE wireless solutions, including RF architecture/interface design, wireless module/chipset selection, antenna integration, RF layout considerations, regulatory constraints and hardware/firmware interfaces.
- Drive design quality, reliability and compliance through technical/design reviews, DFMEA, tolerance and worst-case analysis, component derating, risk assessments, design-change impact analysis and robust verification strategies.
- Own Installed Base and product-lifecycle engineering, including field and manufacturing investigations, CAPA support, reliability improvements, component obsolescence, alternate-part qualification, engineering changes and VCP/design-to-value initiatives.
- Collaborate with Manufacturing, Sourcing and suppliers on DFM/DFT, production testing, yield improvement, supplier transfers, second sourcing, component roadmaps and resolution of manufacturing and supplier-related technical issues.
- Contribute to future product and platform architecture through Advanced Technology Development (ATD), technology roadmaps, platform reuse, standardisation and development of scalable and reusable hardware/system solutions.
- Provide strong technical leadership and drive engineering transformation by independently owning complex deliverables, mentoring engineers, leading cross-functional technical decisions, communicating risks and trade-offs effectively, and leveraging AI-enabled engineering tools to improve engineering quality and productivity.
 
Required Qualifications
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
- 10+ years of relevant experience in electrical/electronic product design and development, with demonstrated ownership of a product, platform or major subsystem.
- Strong hands-on expertise in mixed-signal, analogue, embedded digital, processor/SoC, power, battery/charging and communication circuit design.
- Strong experience in component selection, schematic design, PCB development, board bring-up, integration, testing, debugging and structured root-cause analysis.
- Knowledge and hands-on experience with wireless technologies such as Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, UWB or other short-range wireless technologies, including hardware integration, RF interfaces, antenna considerations, coexistence and wireless performance evaluation.
- Good understanding of EMC/EMI, signal and power integrity, RF/wireless design considerations, electrical safety, thermal design, reliability, component derating and PCB design principles.
- Experience taking hardware through the complete product lifecycle, including requirements flow-down, architecture/design, verification and qualification, manufacturing transfer, engineering changes and lifecycle support, with demonstrated Systems Engineering and product-level thinking.
- Strong technical leadership, independent ownership, troubleshooting and communication skills, with the ability to debug complex hardware, wireless connectivity and system-integration issues and work effectively across global teams, suppliers and manufacturing partners.
 
Preferred Qualifications
- Experience developing medical devices, medical electrical equipment or other regulated, safety-critical or high-reliability products.
- Familiarity with IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-2-25, DFMEA, risk management, tolerance/worst-case analysis and reliability engineering.
- Practical experience in wireless product development and debugging, including RF performance evaluation, antenna integration, link-quality/range issues, interference and coexistence, connectivity failures and hardware/firmware interaction.
- Experience with Installed Base support, CAPA, field investigations, VCP/design-to-value, component obsolescence, alternate-part qualification, and contribution to hardware/system architecture, ATDs or platform development.
- Exposure to BLE/Wi-Fi-enabled products, battery technologies, embedded computing platforms, hardware-related cybersecurity and AI-assisted engineering tools/workflows.

Desired Characteristics
- Strong oral and written communication skills. Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems. Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs. Established project management skills. description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions. 

At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations. 

Your Team's Impact

Python & C++ Software Engineer 3 – Data Access (FIP)
FactSet is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Software Engineer to join our Data Access team — the single, powerful entry point to the FactSet Intelligence Platform (FIP). This is where every interaction begins: AI agents & tools, internal analytics, and client-facing APIs all connect through one unified endpoint and receive responses in a consistent, structured envelope enriched with provenance, source attribution, and entitlement transparency. Operating at the very front of FactSet's data ecosystem, you'll define this client-facing interface and orchestrate the systems behind it, delivering data with exceptional speed, security, reliability, and precision.

The platform handles immense volumes of low-latency requests, so strong engineering discipline is essential — you'll apply best practices in distributed systems, scalability, and performance to build infrastructure that is both resilient and efficient. It's a unique opportunity to shape a critical layer of FactSet's architecture, one that directly shapes the client experience and enables the next generation of intelligent applications. If you're passionate about building high-performance systems, simplifying complex data interactions, and making a measurable impact at scale, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do 
- Design, develop, and deploy the Data Access interface that defines how clients access data.
- Implement query patterns and APIs that balance flexibility, performance, and security.
- Enforce entitlements to ensure clients access only authorized data products.
- Build observability into the layer — end-to-end request tracing, provenance, and source attribution surfaced in responses.
- Leverage metrics and KPIs to optimize query execution, incorporating caching and performance strategies to meet client SLAs.
- Own Data Access products and features, driving bug fixes, performance enhancements, and scalability improvements.
- Collaborate with stakeholders and cross-functional teams to continuously improve development processes.
- Participate in a regional on-call rotation to support production systems.

What We're Looking For
- Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Computer Science or related field.
- 3+ years of software engineering experience with a focus on API development, query systems, or data infrastructure.
- Strong proficiency in Python and C++ with experience building production-grade, client-facing systems.
- Solid understanding of OOP principles and software design patterns.
- Experience with API design and building orchestration layers across multiple backend systems.
- Proven ability to work independently and collaboratively.
- Passion for designing and implementing efficient, scalable, and maintainable software.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with multithreaded programming, low latency, and high-availability systems.
- Knowledge of query engine architecture, parsers, compilers and interpreters.
- Experience implementing caching strategies for query results and metadata.
- Experience with service-oriented architecture and microservices design.
- Understanding of distributed systems and handling failures gracefully across service boundaries.
- Experience working with large-scale data systems and balancing latency, throughput, and cost.
- Background with rate limiting, throttling, and client quota management.

What's In It For You 
At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means: 
- The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up.

title: Engineering Lead
description:
- About NetZhero

NetZhero is developing India's foremost ESG and carbon intelligence platform — an integrated, three-tier system comprising the ESG Compliance Suite, the Carbon Intelligence Module, and the Agri-Forestry Credit Generator. The platform translates complex regulatory frameworks — including the GHG Protocol, BRSR, TCFD, and Verra VCS — into structured, auditable software, enabling enterprises to measure, manage, and report on their sustainability obligations with precision and confidence.

NetZhero operates with a lean, high-ownership engineering team committed to technical rigour, long-term architectural thinking, and delivery discipline. The Engineering Lead is a central and defining role within this team.

- Position Overview

NetZhero is seeking an experienced Engineering Lead to provide both technical leadership and direct, hands-on engineering contribution across the full lifecycle of the platform. This is a dual-function role: the successful candidate will be expected to contribute actively to feature development, architecture, and code delivery while simultaneously providing technical direction, mentorship, and engineering governance to the broader team.

This position is not a purely managerial appointment. NetZhero requires an Engineering Lead who leads by technical example — writing production-quality code on a regular basis, making and owning architectural decisions, and holding the team to a high standard of engineering craft. Candidates who seek to move away from active development are not suited to this role.

The Engineering Lead will work in close collaboration with Product, Architecture, and Business stakeholders to translate the platform's governance, materiality assessment, and Measurement, Reporting, and Verification (MRV) requirements into reliable, scalable, and well-structured software.

- Key Responsibilities

3.1 Hands-On Engineering and Feature Development

- Contribute production-ready code across the full technology stack on a regular and sustained basis, functioning as a primary delivery contributor and not solely in a review or oversight capacity.
- Assume end-to-end technical ownership of significant features and modules across the ESG Compliance Suite, Carbon Intelligence Module, and Agri-Forestry Credit Generator — encompassing design, implementation, testing, and deployment.
- Design and implement data models, API contracts, and service boundaries that underpin the platform's ESG-pillar analytics engines, MRV workflows, and carbon credit calculation pipelines.
- Provide direct technical resolution when complex engineering challenges arise, actively engaging with the problem rather than escalating without contribution.

3.2 Architecture and Technical Direction

- Establish and document architectural decisions for the platform's cloud-native services, ensuring that scalability, security, service ownership, and long-term maintainability are addressed as the team grows.
- Apply appropriate design discipline for the regulatory environment in which the platform operates — with specific attention to auditability, data lineage, versioned calculation logic, and the production of structured outputs suitable for third-party verification.
- Evaluate open-source frameworks and third-party tooling systematically, favouring proven, well-supported components and contributing improvements upstream where appropriate.

3.3 Artificial Intelligence and Agentic Capabilities

- Lead the engineering design and delivery of the platform's agentic AI capabilities, developed using LangGraph, Ollama, and QLoRA fine-tuning workflows, in support of governance automation, double-materiality assessment, and MRV use cases.
- Integrate AI-assisted development tooling — including coding assistants and automated code review systems — into the team's standard development workflow to improve delivery velocity and early defect detection.
- Identify, evaluate, and implement AI and machine learning features that deliver predictive and decision-support intelligence to end users within the ESG and carbon intelligence modules.

3.4 DevOps, Reliability, and Cloud Infrastructure

- Design, implement, and maintain continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines across all platform services, ensuring consistent, repeatable, and automated delivery.
- Own platform reliability, including uptime commitments, observability instrumentation, incident response protocols, and alerting configurations that enable proactive issue identification.
- Manage cloud infrastructure through Infrastructure as Code practices, maintaining cost-efficiency and appropriate environment sizing as platform usage and team scale increase.

3.5 Engineering Quality and Team Development

- Establish, communicate, and enforce code review standards, testing expectations, and coding conventions across the engineering team — functioning as an active reviewer and not merely as a standard-setter.
- Provide structured technical mentorship to engineers across full-stack, cloud, and AI-assisted development disciplines, treating the growth of team capability as a core professional responsibility.
- Define, monitor, and act on engineering quality indicators including test coverage rates, defect escape rates, and code review turnaround times, using these metrics to inform continuous process improvement.

3.6 Delivery Management and Stakeholder Communication

- Monitor and report on engineering delivery health using recognised metrics such as deployment frequency, lead time for changes, and change failure rate, ensuring delivery remains predictable and risks are surfaced early.
- Communicate technical progress, architectural trade-offs, and delivery status to product and business stakeholders in a clear, structured, and timely manner.
- Contribute to the growth and culture of a high-ownership engineering team, maintaining an appropriate balance between delivery speed and the engineering discipline required within a regulated compliance domain.
- Required Qualifications
- Experience: A minimum of 8 years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 2 to 3 years in a technical lead or senior engineering lead role that involved active coding alongside team leadership and architectural responsibility.
- Continued Technical Contribution: Demonstrated commitment to ongoing, regular production coding in recent roles; candidates who have transitioned to exclusively managerial responsibilities are not eligible for this position.
- Full-Stack Proficiency: Substantive, hands-on expertise across the complete technology stack, including React and Next.js on the frontend and Node.js and Python on the backend, with the capability to work effectively at any layer without requiring specialist assistance.
- Cloud and DevOps Competency: Practical, proven experience with cloud platform operations, containerisation technologies, CI/CD pipeline management, and Infrastructure as Code; a demonstrated record of owning production reliability in a professional context.
- Applied AI and Agentic Systems: Demonstrated experience incorporating AI-assisted tools into software development workflows, with preferably direct exposure to building agentic or large language model-powered product features, including familiarity with frameworks such as LangGraph and fine-tuning approaches including LoRA or QLoRA.
- Engineering Quality Leadership: A verifiable track record of improving engineering quality standards within a team through active code review, structured mentorship, and the establishment of practices that endure beyond individual projects.
- Stakeholder Communication: The ability to communicate effectively and independently with product management, technical architecture, and business stakeholders, translating complex engineering considerations into clear, actionable information.
- Preferred Qualifications
- Professional exposure to ESG, carbon accounting, or climate technology domains, including working knowledge of frameworks such as the GHG Protocol, BRSR, Verra VCS, or comparable standards.
- Experience designing and operating data-intensive platforms in which calculation accuracy, data lineage, and auditability are non-negotiable requirements.
- Contributions to open-source software projects or published technical writing that demonstrates depth of expertise and engagement with the engineering community.
- Familiarity with spatial or geospatial data systems with relevance to agri-forestry carbon sequestration analysis and land-use modelling.
- Technical Environment

Frontend

React.js, Next.js

Backend

Node.js, Python

AI & Agentic

LangGraph, Ollama, LoRA / QLoRA Fine-Tuning Workflows

Cloud & Infra

Microsoft Azure / AWS / GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform (or equivalent IaC)

DevOps & SRE

GitHub Actions (or equivalent CI/CD), Prometheus / Grafana (or equivalent observability stack)

AI-Assisted Dev

GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or equivalent AI coding and review assistants

Data

Relational (SQL) and Non-Relational (NoSQL) databases

- What NetZhero Offers
- The opportunity to engineer a platform of genuine societal significance — ESG and carbon intelligence infrastructure at a moment of substantial and growing regulatory and market demand.
- Significant technical autonomy and ownership from the outset, with direct influence over architectural decisions and platform direction.
- A professional engineering culture that prioritises code quality, peer review discipline, and the continuous development of team capability.
- Competitive total compensation commensurate with experience, a flexible hybrid working arrangement, and the prospect of professional growth within a company at a consequential stage of its development.

description:
Company Description Aventis is an ERP-native cross-border B2B payments platform that uses stablecoins and AI-driven routing to make international B2B and supplier payments faster, cheaper, and fully automated from existing finance systems. The platform helps enterprises and mid-market companies reduce cross-border payment costs through lower network fees and improved FX, while cutting settlement times from days to minutes or same-day where supported. Aventis is designed for CFOs, controllers, and AP leaders who want modern, API-like cross-border payments instead of slow, opaque traditional banking processes.
Location: Bangalore or Hyderabad, India

What you'll do:
- Design, build and operate Go services that orchestrate multi-step transactions across internal systems and third-party providers.
- Make every operation safe to repeat: idempotency keys, deduplication and exactly-once effects on top of at-least-once delivery.
- Implement automated retries with exponential backoff and jitter, timeouts and clear handling of terminal failures.
- Build secure webhook ingestion (signature verification, replay protection, durable queuing) and reliable outbound webhook dispatch to partners.

 About the Team Authentication tells you who someone is. Authorization decides what they can do, and doing that well at scale is hard. Role-based access breaks down as applications grow, and AI agents are changing who, and what, asks for access. Auth0 FGA solves this with fine-grained authorization. Its engine is OpenFGA, a CNCF incubating open source project that Okta maintains with contributors from other companies, and Auth0 FGA runs that same engine as a managed service.
FGA DevEx owns how developers experience both: our SDKs, CLI, IDE plugins, Helm charts and docs, all developed in the open. The FGA group owns its product end to end, from infrastructure to docs, so we move quickly and see our work reach developers.
Our guiding principle: one developer experience, many deployment models.

From there, you'll shape where the developer experience goes next, from how our SDKs evolve to new surfaces like MCP servers. description:
Company: The Alter Office

Website: Visit Website
