Job Description

Our Story

At The Alter Office, we build what comes next. We operate as an internal innovation lab, creating stealth products, new business bets, and high-leverage systems designed to unlock disproportionate value for us and our partner company ITW Consulting.

Our work is not centered around being a conventional service partner. Instead, we focus on building products and platforms that solve complex, strategic problems and create long-term advantage. Where needed, we have stepped in on critical opportunities beyond the usual scope, especially when speed, product thinking, and execution depth mattered most.

About The Role

We are building a holistic AdTech platform that delivers premium value to both advertisers and publishers, and the backend is where that entire ecosystem actually runs - the ad marketplace, campaign creation, ad-serving decisioning, analytics collection, attribution, and ROAS measurement.

Concretely, that means large-scale architecture: the ad-serving systems that make real-time decisioning calls at volume, the scalable data platforms that ingest and process billions of events a day, the analytics platforms that turn that data into attribution and ROAS numbers advertisers and publishers trust, and the autonomous AI agents we're building to automate campaign optimization and decisioning across the platform.

We are looking for a Backend Engineer who wants to be genuinely involved in building these areas out - not just implementing tickets, but understanding the product and system tradeoffs behind them - and who'll grow into owning larger pieces of the platform over time.

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build, and maintain the backend systems and APIs behind our ad marketplace, campaign management, and analytics/attribution pipelines.
- Contribute to the scalable data platforms and ad-serving systems that process and act on data at volume.
- Help build and maintain the backend infrastructure behind our autonomous AI agents.
- Collaborate with product, other backend engineers, and DevOps to ship end-to-end features.
- Model and manage data using SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis), including caching where useful.
- Implement authentication, authorization, and data security practices under senior engineers' guidance.
- Write clean, well-documented, well-tested code.
- Deploy, monitor, and scale services on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
- Use Docker (and optionally Kubernetes) for containerization of backend services.
- Contribute to and help maintain CI/CD pipelines.
- Monitor and debug production issues using observability tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
- Participate actively in code reviews and contribute to team development standards.
- Work within event-driven or microservices architectures, using tools like GraphQL, WebSockets, or message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ) where they fit the problem.

Requirements

- 2–4 years of professional backend engineering experience.
- Deep experience with a backend language and its ecosystem (e.g., Node.js/Express, Python, Java, Go); comfortable owning services end-to-end in production.
- Strong understanding of RESTful API design and asynchronous programming.
- Solid experience with relational and NoSQL databases, including basic data modeling.
- Familiarity with Docker, Git, and modern CI/CD workflows.
- Hands-on experience deploying to cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
- Working knowledge of backend security best practices.
- Strong problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills.
- Comfortable in a fast-paced, agile environment with evolving priorities.
- Exposure to monitoring, logging, or performance profiling in production is a plus.
- Experience with message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ) or GraphQL is a plus.
- Experience with Kubernetes is a plus.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Meet the Team

At Cisco Meraki, our intuitive platform enables organizations of all sizes to deliver customer and employee experiences at scale. To provide best-in-class technologies to our customers, we've created an unrivaled company culture for our employees. One that is collaborative, flexible, and inclusive and provides employees with the autonomy to develop technology that's intuitive, secure, and accessible for everyone.

Our Dashboard teams build and maintain our Web applications, which manage millions of network devices from our cloud. Our customers use the Meraki Dashboard to monitor and configure critical IT infrastructure that serves tens of millions of people every day.

Your Impact

As a Full Stack Software Engineer, you will collaborate with firmware and other Backend, SRE, Dashboard engineers to architect, design, and build a large-scale system. You will enable connections between over a million network devices and our products. With the large footprint that we have, quality is our highest priority. With help from product managers and firmware engineers, you will construct intuitive but powerful systems that will be used by customers via the Meraki Dashboard.

- Design & develop scalable software systems and enhancing backend features.
- Collaborate with engineers from Backend, SRE, Dashboard, and Support teams to ensure seamless integration, maintain system reliability, enhance user interfaces, and provide comprehensive support for end-users.
- Identify and address performance issues.
- Follow established coding standards and contribute insights to improve team knowledge.

Minimum Qualifications

- 7+ years of experience writing production code and tests for medium to large-scale systems.
- 7+ years of experience in full stack technologies, such as Ruby on Rails/Python/ react.js, JavaScript.
- Ability to design efficient databases and optimize query performance in a relational database like Postgres.
- Demonstrates ownership of tasks within the development process, from conception to implementation, by collaborating effectively with peers and cross-functional teams.
- A keen interest in understanding user needs and contributing to product development.
- Strong communication skills to articulate ideas clearly and work effectively within a team.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building cloud-based infrastructure and services (e.g. Web applications)
- Experience or interest in Security or Networking
- Experience with Container solutions (Kubernetes)

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
- begin with screening or an interview
- originate from a Cisco email address, and
- be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https://careers.cisco.com or cisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.

Job Title: R&D Senior Member of Technical Staff

Location: Bangalore, India

Employment Type: Regular, full-time, hybrid work arrangement

The job 

We are seeking a self-driven Senior Software Engineer to help design and build the foundation that powers our industrial software portfolio in the cloud. You’ll work on Microsoft Azure to deliver scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions that enable customers to reduce IT costs and accelerate digital transformation. This is a collaborative, fast-paced environment where you’ll partner with architects and engineers to solve complex technical challenges while continuing to grow your cloud expertise.

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and implement cloud solutions on Microsoft Azure, ensuring scalability, performance, and security
- Collaborate with architects and engineers to deliver infrastructure and data solutions aligned with business and compliance requirements
- Evaluate system architecture, perform risk analysis, and implement mitigation strategies
- Implement secure development practices and support compliance and security-related activities
- Develop and maintain technical documentation, including system designs and implementation artifacts
- Mentor/guide junior engineers on routine issues / Review junior engineer’s work/delivery
- Continuously grow your technical skills in an environment of rapidly evolving technology
- Owns project deliveries, procedures and designs within the role

Essential Requirements

- 7+ years of strong software development experience in C# (.NET), React.js, WEB/REST API’s, SQL servers
- Hands-on experience designing and implementing cloud solutions, preferably on Azure
- Hands-on / Familiarity with Azure Functions, App Services, Service Fabric, Networking, Storage technologies and Auth0/Identity server concepts
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and containerized environments
- Hands-on / Familiarity with security tools / SDL process
- Familiarity with IaaS/SaaS/PaaS architecture and microservice architecture
- Familiarity in migrating projects from legacy to latest technologies
- Solid understanding of cloud architecture, Infrastructure as a Service, microservices, networking, and authentication/authorization concepts
- Strong understanding of secure software development practices, including threat modeling
- Good communication skills, working with a broad range of people, including Architects and Testers.

Desired Skills And Competencies

- Curiosity to explore emerging cloud and security technologies and apply them effectively (Curiosity)
- Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to deliver secure, scalable solutions to complex challenges (Impact)
- Effective collaboration and communication when working with customers and cross-functional teams (Trust)
- Ability to manage priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high-quality outcomes (Aspiration)

R&D at AVEVA

Our global team of 2000+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the centre of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name.

Our track record of innovation is no fluke – it’s the result of a structured and deliberate focus on learning, collaboration and inclusivity. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us.

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/r-and-d-careers/

India Benefits include:

Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well-being support

It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/

Hybrid working

We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.

Hiring process

Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring-process

About AVEVA

AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.

We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability-report.aveva.com/

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/

AVEVA requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a drug screening and comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.

AVEVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. AVEVA provides reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities where appropriate. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, please notify your recruiter. Determinations on requests for reasonable accommodation will be made on a case-by-case basis.

title: Software Engineer II
description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.

Team Overview

The Core Applications team takes pride in providing exceptional support and innovative solutions for a diverse range of essential applications and tools, including Agent Desktop Plus, Supervisor Plus, Admin Console, iPad Supervisor, Freedom Application Platform, Internal Admin (Shell), Agent Assist UI, Nimbus, and Unified Portal / Login.

We have a passion for excellence. Our dedicated team is committed to optimizing user experiences, streamlining workflows, and enhancing productivity across the board. Whether empowering agents with intuitive interfaces, empowering supervisors with powerful management tools, or enabling seamless access to critical applications via multiple platforms, we strive to deliver with utmost efficiency and customer satisfaction.

Our mission is to shape the future of Five9, where innovation and collaboration go hand in hand as we strive to build a world-class ecosystem of integrated solutions that cater to the ever-evolving needs of our valued users.

Role Overview

The Core Applications team is doing greenfield work, introducing new concepts and capabilities to our suite of UI products on a modern React + TypeScript stack.

As a Software Engineer, you'll build features and take ownership of well-scoped work end-to-end. You'll collaborate closely with engineers across a distributed team spanning Australia, India, and the US. AI tools are a core part of how we work every day.

Key Responsibilities

- Build and ship features on the new agent desktop in React + TypeScript + Nx, using AI coding agents as part of the daily workflow
- Take ownership of well-scoped work end-to-end, from implementation to testing to deployment
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to the shared quality bar
- Collaborate async-first with engineering, product, and design across distributed time zones
- Contribute to async planning via Jira, written documentation, and Slack

Qualifications & Skills

- Strong React and TypeScript proficiency; experience with other modern frameworks (Vue, Angular, Svelte) is a good signal
- Testing experience with Jest and/or Playwright, with an understanding of the value of thorough test coverage
- Able to operate autonomously on a small, fast-paced team; fills gaps and makes reasonable calls without constant direction
- Strong written communication and collaboration skills for a remote, async-first, distributed environment
- Prior experience using AI coding tools and a genuine willingness to evolve those skills as the space changes
- Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in a relevant discipline

Preferred Skills

- Prior experience in CCaaS, agent desktop, or UI platform roles
- Familiarity with TanStack Query and Zustand
- Web accessibility knowledge; familiarity with WCAG standards and building accessible UIs
- Monorepo and micro-frontend architecture experience; Nx preferred, but PNPM, Lerna, and other tools are good signals
- Experience with WebSockets or real-time application development

Other Requirements

- Working shift must be aligned to overlap with Pacific working hours
- This position requires the ability to be On Call

Key Relationships

There are no direct reports to this role.

Key stakeholders include:

- Service owners and their teams
- Technical leadership and senior management, including VPs
- Engineering teams
- Network and Telecom teams
- Customer service teams
- Compliance and infosec teams

This is not a customer-facing role.

This role is hybrid and requires 3 days a week in office.

Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.  The more inclusive we are, the better we are.  Five9 is an equal opportunity employer.

Five9 is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@five9.com to request an accommodation. Requests will be handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable law.

View our privacy policy, including our privacy notice to California residents here: https://www.five9.com/pt-pt/legal.

Note: Five9 will never request that an applicant send money as a prerequisite for commencing employment with Five9.

title: Software Development Engineer I
description:
Most boards and executives are currently flying blind when it comes to cyber risk. They are guessing. At Safe, we’ve built an AI-driven engine that finally gives the C-Suite a clear, quantified, and real-time view of their security posture. We don’t just provide data; we provide certainty.

We are a $170M Series C-funded category leader. We don’t play in the mid-market; we operate at the highest levels of global enterprise. Today, we are proud to serve 10% of the Fortune 500, protecting global icons such as Apple, Netflix, AT&T, Verizon, and Victoria’s Secret.

As we scale toward our next chapter, we are looking for high-performers who want to do the best work of their careers at the intersection of AI and Cybersecurity.
The Culture Memo: Our Operating System

Safe is not a typical corporate environment. We are a high-intensity, mission-driven team. We value builders who want to define a category and work alongside people who are equally committed to excellence.
- Extreme Ownership: We don’t do "not my job." We hire people who see a gap and own the solution from start to finish.
- The Elite Standard: We serve the most sophisticated companies on the planet. Our work must be bulletproof. Whether it’s a line of code or a sales deck, we aim for Tier-1 quality every time.
- Methodology & Rigor: We don’t wing it. From Force Management and MEDDICC in sales to data-driven sprints in engineering, we rely on proven frameworks to stay disciplined and predictable.
- Radical Candor: We move too fast for politics or sugar-coating. We value direct, honest feedback that helps us find the right answer quickly.
- The Series C Hustle: We have the stability of a well-funded leader but the heart of a startup.

The Perks & Ownership:
We want our team to feel like owners because they are owners. We trust our people to manage their results and their time.
- Meaningful Equity: Every "Safestar" is a shareholder. You aren’t just an employee; you are a partner in our success.
- Unlimited Leaves: We don’t believe in clock-watching. We offer unlimited leave because we trust you to take the time you need to recharge while staying committed to the mission.
- Comprehensive Benefits: We provide top-tier medical insurance and wellness benefits to ensure you and your family are well cared for.
- Career Trajectory: We are growing aggressively. For high-performers, the path for advancement moves at the speed of your ambition.

Years of Experience: 1-3 years
Locations: Bengaluru

Core Responsibilities
- Code Mastery: Own feature development and write clean, efficient, maintainable, and production-quality code that drives the product forward.
- Technical Contribution: Participate actively in architecture and design discussions and contribute to building scalable, secure, and high-performance solutions.
- Code Review: Conduct thorough code reviews to maintain code quality, identify opportunities for improvement, and provide constructive feedback to other engineers.
- Cloud Integration: Work with cloud services such as AWS Lambda, API Gateway, EC2, S3, RDS, and other relevant AWS services to build and optimize cloud-based solutions.
- Problem Solving: Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical problems by identifying root causes and implementing effective, scalable solutions.
- Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, designers, engineers, and other stakeholders to ensure technical solutions are aligned with product and business objectives.
- Project Execution: Contribute to project planning and execution and take ownership of delivering features within agreed timelines and scope.

Qualifications/ Experience/ Essential Skills:
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
- 1–3 years of professional software development experience building scalable backend systems.
- Strong proficiency in Go, Python, or Node.js for backend development.
- Experience designing and building RESTful APIs and microservices architectures.
- Solid understanding of distributed systems concepts such as concurrency, caching, asynchronous processing, and fault tolerance.
- Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
- Experience building and deploying applications in containerized environments using Docker and Kubernetes.
- Strong understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases, including performance optimization techniques.
- Experience participating in system design discussions and architecture decisions.
- Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with a high degree of ownership.
- Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
- Working knowledge of Generative AI and LLM fundamentals, including how LLMs work, tokens, context windows, prompting, hallucinations, and common limitations.

If you’re passionate about cyber risk, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to be part of a team that’s redefining security, we want to hear from you! 🚀

title: Generative AI -Software Engineer-Senior Associate
description:
The Opportunity

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.

As a Generative AI - Software Engineer - Senior Associate, you will play a pivotal role in transforming raw data into actionable insights, enabling informed decision-making and driving business growth. Within our Data and Analytics Engineering practice, you will leverage advanced analytics and statistical techniques to extract insights from large datasets, focusing on exploratory and descriptive analysis, statistical modeling, and creating data visualizations to solve complex business problems and inform strategic decisions.

As a Senior Associate, you will build meaningful client connections and learn how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality work while embracing increased ambiguity. You will use critical thinking to break down complex concepts and develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is evolving.

In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will respond effectively to diverse perspectives, needs, and feelings of others, using a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems. You will uphold and reinforce professional and technical standards, contributing to the firm's overall business strategies.

Responsibilities

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business needs and translate them into backend functionalities for GenAI and Agentic AI projects.
- Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend solutions, including event-driven architectures and integration with external systems/APIs.
- Manage data storage solutions using relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB) databases to support AI applications in production.
- Utilize containerization (Kubernetes) and implement DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions), for efficient deployment and scalability.
- Build and integrate APIs using Python frameworks (Flask, FastAPI) and collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and DevOps teams for seamless AI model deployment.

What You Must Have

- Bachelor's & Master's Degree
- 4 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart

- Proficient with LLM interaction frameworks like LangChain, Semantic Kernel, and LlamaIndex, and experienced in integrating, scaling, and deploying GenAI and agentic applications in production.
- Skilled in setting up data pipelines for both model training and real-time inference to support AI workloads efficiently.
- Advanced Python expertise including OOP, asynchronous programming (asyncio), concurrency (multithreading, multiprocessing), design patterns, memory management, and performance optimization for scalable GenAI systems.
- Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, software design principles (SOLID, clean architecture), and hands-on experience with cloud-native development on Azure/AWS, including serverless, microservices, and container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker).
- Experience with additional OOP languages (Java, C++, C#) and familiarity with WebSocket implementations for real-time application functionality.

title: Associate Software Engineer
description:
About the Role
We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Associate Software Engineer to join our engineering team. The ideal candidate should have a strong foundation in programming, problem-solving, and software development fundamentals, along with a willingness to learn new technologies and contribute to real-world engineering projects.
You will work closely with experienced engineers to design, develop, test, debug, and maintain scalable software applications.

Key Responsibilities
- Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications based on business requirements.
- Write clean, efficient, maintainable, and reusable code.
- Collaborate with senior engineers, product managers, and QA teams to deliver high-quality software.
- Participate in code reviews and follow established coding standards and best practices.
- Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve software defects and technical issues.
- Develop and integrate APIs and work with databases.
- Participate in Agile development processes, including sprint planning and daily stand-ups.
- Write unit tests and support application testing and debugging.
- Stay updated with emerging technologies, development tools, and software engineering practices.
- Contribute to technical documentation and continuous improvement initiatives.

Required Skills & Qualifications

- Strong understanding of programming fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms.
- Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Java, Python, JavaScript, C++, or C#.
- Basic knowledge of object-oriented programming (OOP) concepts.
- Familiarity with SQL and relational databases.
- Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and software testing fundamentals.
- Basic knowledge of REST APIs and web development concepts.
- Familiarity with Git or other version control systems.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
- Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team.
- Willingness to learn, adapt, and work with new technologies.

Preferred Qualifications

- Internship experience or academic project experience in software development.
- Familiarity with frameworks such as Spring Boot, React, Angular, Django, or similar technologies.
- Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
- Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, Docker, or automated testing tools.
- Contributions to GitHub projects or participation in coding competitions.

What We Offer
- Opportunities to work on real-world software engineering projects.
- Mentorship and technical guidance from experienced engineers.
- Exposure to modern technologies and development practices.
- A collaborative environment that encourages innovation and continuous learning.
- Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.

Ideal Candidate Profile
We are looking for candidates who demonstrate:
- A strong foundation in computer science and programming.
- A passion for building software and solving technical challenges.
- A proactive attitude toward learning and problem-solving.
- The ability to take ownership of assigned tasks and deliver results.
- A commitment to writing quality code and continuously improving technical skills.

title: Software Engineer II
description:
Join Resideo's P&S Tech Engineering team to build cloud solutions that power connected products and customer services . You will collaborate with experienced engineers on complex integration and modernization initiatives, strengthen your technical capabilities, and contribute new ideas and solutions.

As a Cloud Integration Engineer, you will contribute to connected-device integrations, device migrations, cloud application modernization, and Azure App Service migrations. You will gain hands-on experience developing, integrating, deploying, migrating, and supporting production cloud services across the software engineering lifecycle.

Job Duties

- Build and maintain integrations among devices, events, APIs, and downstream cloud services.

- Apply engineering practices such as unit and integration testing, code reviews, static analysis, performance testing, and cybersecurity controls. 
- Use AI-assisted development and testing tools to improve productivity and code quality.

- Implement technical improvements that enhance application design, performance, reliability, and maintainability. 
- Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives. 
- Partner with Product Owners, engineering, QA, DevOps/SRE, and Customer Operations teams to deliver features and resolve technical or production issues. 
- Own assigned work, troubleshoot issues, and continuously expand technical and domain knowledge.

What We're Looking For

- AI-native engineers. You use AI to raise your bar, not just move faster forming your own hypotheses, pressure-testing and verifying AI output, catching its errors, and taking full ownership of code quality regardless of how it was produced. You stay current with a fast-moving toolset.
- Comfort in unfamiliar code. You ramp fast into systems you didn't write, reason about blast radius, and de-risk changes rather than hoping they work.
- Architectural ownership & operational readiness. You design for scale and availability, anticipate failure modes, and build with monitoring and alerting from the start.
- Ownership start to finish. Just because a project has been deployed doesn't mean it's done. You own outcomes , think end to end in terms of product and are customer obsessed

- Proactivity. You act without being told, identify areas of improvement, and drive best practices.
- Comfort with ambiguity. You can operate without a fully-specified problem and bring structure to it.
- Organization & planning. You break large projects into smaller pieces that are easier to estimate and deliver.
- Strong communication. Clear in writing and in person, across technical and non-technical audiences.

Qualifications

- Minimum 8+ years of industry experience in backend development, at least 3-4 years in senior positions, building large-scale applications with right observability.
- Solid computer science fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design
- Fluency using AI tools in real development work, plus the judgment to verify and pressure-test their output rather than trusting it blindly
- Experience developing distributed web applications
- Write code that is comprehensible, well-structured, and highly performant
- Experience with database modeling (SQL or NoSQL both fine)
- Experience using and designing RESTful services

Nice to have: BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or similar; GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, Mongo, Redis, Ruby on Rails, Microservices, Machine Learning

Evidence Services

- Build functionality for evidence checklists, evidence states, notes, uploads, attachment metadata, retrieval, reminders, evidence packages, and secure file access.

PostgreSQL Development

- Create and maintain PostgreSQL tables, relationships, indexes, views, and migrations.

API Development

- Implement APIs supporting create/read/update operations, queue filtering, sorting, pagination, searching, case assignment, comments, notifications, evidence management, reports, merchant metrics, compliance information, and automation actions.

Payment & Prevention Integrations

Prevention Alerts

Automation Rules

- Implement configurable automation rules including triggers, actions, merchant/MID scope, portfolio scope, active/paused states, automatic vs. review modes, guardrails, execution, run history, success/failure tracking, and savings calculations.

Merchant & Compliance Data

- Develop APIs and SQL queries for merchant health, chargeback ratios, processing volume, win rates, alert counts, historical trends, compliance thresholds, compliance status, portfolio KPIs, fee exposure, and root-cause analytics.
- Assist with background processes used to calculate and refresh these metrics.

Reporting

- Implement services for scheduled and on-demand reports, CSV/XLSX exports, report histories, scheduling, recipient management, and operational/compliance extracts.
- Develop asynchronous processes for reports or data jobs that should not execute synchronously through API requests.

Azure Development

- Deploy and maintain backend services within the established Azure architecture using Azure-hosted Python applications, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Blob Storage, Key Vault, Service Bus, Functions or container-based services, Azure Monitor, and Application Insights as applicable.

Security & Auditability

- Implement backend controls supporting role-based permissions, secure authentication, SSO/MFA-compatible workflows, session security, data redaction, retention, audit logs, API-rate controls, and secure handling of secrets and credentials.
- Maintain detailed logging for sensitive case and automation actions.

Testing & Quality

- Write unit tests for backend business logic and integration tests for APIs and database operations.
- Test external integration failure scenarios, participate in regression testing and defect resolution, maintain technical documentation, and troubleshoot services using Azure observability tools.

Required Qualifications

- 3-5 years of professional software engineering experience.
- 2+ years of backend development experience using .Net.
- Strong SQL skills.
- Experience working with PostgreSQL or another enterprise relational database.
- Experience developing REST APIs and understanding relational database design.
- Familiarity with Git-based development workflows.
- Experience writing unit and integration tests.
- Experience with cloud-based application development.
- Familiarity with Docker/containerized applications.
- Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to work within an established architecture while contributing technical recommendations.

Preferred Qualifications

- FastAPI experience.
- SQLAlchemy and Alembic experience.
- Azure Database for PostgreSQL experience.

description:
Job Description

Job Title – SOFTWARE ENGINEER

The Purpose of This Role

Fidelity Investments Enterprise Infrastructure is seeking a Software Engineer to design, build, modernize and support secure automation solutions and web applications that simplify IT operations. The role combines strong .NET and Python engineering with disciplined DevOps practices, production support, and a compliance-first approach to software delivery. You will collaborate with technology partners to translate operational needs into maintainable, observable and scalable solutions. Exposure to AI-assisted engineering, intelligent automation or Generative AI is an added advantage. The role is based in Bengaluru, India.

The Value You Deliver

- Design, develop and maintain reliable applications, APIs, automation services and utilities using .NET and Python.
- Build solutions that reduce manual IT operations through workflow automation, self-service and reusable engineering patterns.
- Own engineering quality across requirements, design, development, code review, testing, deployment, monitoring, support and continuous improvement.
- Embed DevOps practices through source control, automated builds, CI/CD, repeatable deployments, environment configuration, observability and operational readiness.
- Follow secure software development, change management, vulnerability remediation, auditability and applicable enterprise compliance requirements as part of day-to-day engineering.
- Partner with infrastructure, security, risk and business teams to ensure solutions are supportable and aligned with technology standards and roadmaps.
- Diagnose production issues, perform root-cause analysis and implement durable remediation.
- Contribute to Agile planning, technical documentation, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
- Evaluate modern engineering capabilities, including AI-assisted development and intelligent automation, where they improve productivity or solution quality.

The Skills That Are Key To This Role

- Hands-on application development using C#, .NET / modern .NET and ASP.NET Core, including RESTful APIs and service integration.
- Strong Python programming skills for automation, APIs, data processing or backend services.
- Solid software engineering fundamentals: object-oriented design, API design, error handling, logging, unit/integration testing, debugging and code quality.
- Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL, such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL or MySQL.
- Practical experience with Git-based source control and collaborative code-review workflows.
- Strong understanding of CI/CD using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions or equivalent enterprise pipelines, including automated quality and security checks.
- Experience packaging and deploying applications using Docker; familiarity with Kubernetes or container orchestration is valuable.
- Understanding of configuration and secrets management, release controls, rollback/recovery, monitoring and production support.
- Awareness of secure coding, dependency/vulnerability management and the importance of SDLC, change-control, risk and compliance evidence throughout delivery.
- Ability to communicate clearly, work across teams and learn new technologies quickly.

DevOps, Security & Compliance Expectations

- Treat CI/CD, automated testing, security scanning and deployment validation as foundational engineering controls.
- Maintain traceability from source change through build, approval and deployment, with clear documentation and auditable evidence where required.
- Use approved patterns for secrets, privileged access, dependencies and environment configuration; avoid hard-coded credentials or unmanaged configuration.
- Build observability through structured logging, health checks, actionable monitoring and support documentation.
- Address vulnerabilities, technical debt and operational risks with the same ownership as functional defects.
- Design for controlled, repeatable releases with appropriate environment separation and recovery/rollback considerations.

Skills That Are Good to Have / Added Advantage

- AI / Generative AI exposure, such as AI-assisted workflows, enterprise-approved LLM services, prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), evaluation or responsible AI practices.
- Experience using AI coding assistants while maintaining code-review, security, IP and compliance controls.
- Cloud engineering experience with Azure or AWS, including application hosting, managed services or migration patterns.
- Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation tooling such as Terraform, PowerShell or equivalent.
- Working knowledge of microservices, event-driven integration or distributed application patterns.
- Working knowledge of Java and the Spring / Spring Boot ecosystem for backend services, APIs or enterprise application development.
- Front-end development experience with modern Angular, TypeScript, HTML and CSS.

How Your Work Impacts The Organization

FITG (FMR India Technology Group) supports IT capabilities and technology delivery for Fidelity India. In this role, you will help improve engineering productivity and operational resilience by replacing manual activities with well-engineered, supportable automation. Strong DevOps and compliance practices are central to this impact: they help solutions move from development to production in a controlled, repeatable and auditable manner while remaining secure and maintainable.

The Expertise We’re Looking For

- 2 to 4 years of relevant software development or engineering experience.
- B.E., B.Tech., M.Tech. or equivalent relevant qualification/experience.
- Demonstrated hands-on delivery in .NET and/or Python across the application lifecycle.
- Practical ownership mindset for production quality, DevOps discipline, security and compliance.

title: Software Development Engineer
description:
At NI IP Routing SW, we believe in fostering a flat and non-hierarchical work environment. We are obsessed about delivering high-quality products and ensure the utmost level of excellence in everything we do. We are a passionate bunch and strive to be technological leaders in our industry. You will be integral to a close-knit team to engineer best-in-class products for the most critical networks data centers for web/hyper-scalers, telcos and enterprises (including AI fabrics), and communication service provider networks.

We are looking for SW engineers who wish to be a part of developing and evolving the current and next generation of routers that form the core of anything internet. These routers are at the heart of Nokias IP product offerings, from data centers (including AI fabrics) to providing strong, resilient low latency and dependable IP backhaul for service providers and mission critical networks. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with one of the best engineering teams in the industry. We value your expertise and offer an environment where you can thrive both professionally and personally. There are more customers we want to win, more networks to penetrate, more technologies to enable and more applications to support. We want to make smaller products, and we want to make bigger products. We want to build products based on newer standards and newer ASICS in the market.

You will play a critical role in designing and implementing high-performance data path solutions on both custom and merchant silicon. You will be responsible for writing efficient and modular code that is well-tested and robust, ensuring that it meets the high standards required for the most critical networks. Your role will involve working on advanced packet forwarding techniques in IP, MPLS, Segment Routing, VxLANs. You will also contribute into Traffic Management technologies - QoS (Policers, Schedulers, Shapers), ACLs, TCAM Management, and Packet Extractions to CPU. DCN2026.

HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE AND WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

* Design and implementation: You will gain deep expertise in designing and implementing datapath solutions on both custom and merchant silicon.
* Advanced packet forwarding: Develop your skills in IP, MPLS, Segment Routing, VXLANs, and QoS technologies such as Policers, Schedulers, and ACLs.  
  DPDK and performance optimization: You''ll be working with DPDK and similar technologies to maximize performance for high-throughput systems.
* Virtualized environments: Expand your knowledge in working with virtualized Linux environments such as KVM and Dockers.
* Team collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including product management and software testers, to deliver customer-driven solutions.
* Robust and modular code: Focus on writing modular, maintainable code that is well unit-tested, improving your coding skills and best practices.

Qualifications

* Bachelor''s degree with 3-10 years of Experience.
* Proven experience in packet forwarding technologies (IP, MPLS, Segment Routing, VXLANs).
* Experience with QoS technologies (Policers, Schedulers, ACLs) and TCAM management.
* Hands-on experience with DPDK for high-performance packet processing.
* Proficiency in C/C++ programming, with a focus on networking solutions.
* Contributions to SONiC or other open-source networking projects (desirable).
* Methodical problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Experience working in virtualized Linux environments (e.g., KVM, Docker, etc.).
* Passion for networking technologies and high-performance systems.

title: Software Development Engineer - Routing Platforms
description:
### Meet the Team

Our Routing SD-WAN Group is at the forefront of innovation, delivering intelligent, secure, and scalable WAN edge solutions that empower enterprises to connect and protect their networks from the edge to the cloud. Within this group, the Routing Platform Software team builds industry-leading headend SD-WAN and edge routing platforms. We are a high-energy group working on next-generation routing and services at a global scale, connecting thousands of devices and millions of users.

### Your Impact

We are looking for a software engineer to develop and evolve the forwarding and platform software that powers SD-WAN and edge routing. In this role, you will collaborate with ASIC, hardware, and cross-functional engineering teams to define new architectures, implement high-performance packet forwarding, and deliver robust, production-ready features. You will leverage modern AI tools to enhance software development practices, helping to drive greater efficiency, quality, and innovation across the team.

### Responsibilities

* **Hardware-Software Integration:** Collaborate closely with hardware engineering teams to bring up new platforms, develop low-level drivers, and integrate Network Interface Modules (NIMs).
* **Firmware Development:** Design, implement, and maintain ROMMON and bootloader software to ensure secure and reliable system initialization.
* **Forwarding Plane Optimization:** Develop and tune high-performance forwarding plane software to meet the rigorous demands of modern secure routing environments.
* **Performance Debugging:** Perform deep-dive analysis into performance bottlenecks at the kernel and hardware-abstraction layers, including the control plane.
* **Modern Development Practices:** Utilize modern development workflows, including AI-assisted coding tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or Codex) and integrated development environments like VSCode, to accelerate the development lifecycle.

### Minimum Qualifications

* 4-8 years of industry experience with end-to-end software development in networking, including platforms, system software, kernel/user-space drivers, bootloaders, and BIOS.
* Strong proficiency in C/C++ with a focus on systems programming and Linux environments.
* Proven experience in developing device drivers and working with RTOS/Linux kernels.
* Solid understanding of routing architectures and Layer 2/Layer 3 networking protocols (e.g., Ethernet, VLANs, STP).
* Experience with bootloaders (ROMMON), hardware bring-up, and board support packages (BSP).

### Preferred Qualifications

* Knowledge of high-speed interfaces (PHY, MAC, MACSEC) and DPDK.
* Debugging experience with hardware interfaces (i2c, PCIe) and hardware/software debuggers (e.g., GDB, Arium, BDI).
* Knowledge of x86 or ARM assembly code, instruction sets, and ABIs.
* Experience with AI/ML techniques and tools for development (e.g., code assistants, static analysis tools, test automation platforms).
* Strong collaborative skills and the ability to debug complex issues spanning hardware, firmware, and software layers.

title: Software Engineer II
description:

Equifax is seeking creative, high-energy and driven **software engineers** with hands-on development skills to work on a variety of meaningful projects. Our software engineering positions provide you the opportunity to join a team of talented engineers working with leading-edge technology. You are ideal for this position if you are a forward-thinking, committed, and enthusiastic software engineer who is passionate about technology.  
  
**What you’ll do**

* Monitoring & System Health: Continuously monitor microservices, system integration flows, and Linux server environments to proactively identify performance bottlenecks and system failures.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Perform deep-dive log analysis and post-incident root cause investigations for complex outages, driving permanent resolution items across engineering teams.
* Environment & Deployment Maintenance: Execute standard operational tasks including environment configuration changes, system updates, application deployments, file backups, and routine health checks.
* Escalation & Collaboration: Serve as the primary operational liaison to core development teams—escalating unresolvable software defects while driving cross-team action items to completion.
* Runbooks & Documentation: Create and update technical documentation, system runbooks, and SOPs to streamline incident resolution and team onboarding.

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
* Minimum 2 to 5 years of experience IT support
* 2+ years experience working with Linux scripting, troubleshooting, resolving issues within SLA.
* 2+ years of experience with cloud-based solutions such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. Customer service oriented with good problem solving attitude
* 2+ years experience with software testing, performance, and quality engineering techniques and strategies

title: Software Engineer II
description:

This role is intended for engineers who already have professional software development or platform engineering experience and are looking to build deeper expertise within a large-scale enterprise environment. Associate Engineers will work closely with experienced engineers while taking ownership of increasingly complex development assignments. * Develop and support integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise platforms using **REST APIs, web services, events, and related integration technologies**.

* Develop, test, deploy, and support enterprise solutions on the **ServiceNow platform**.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Overview
The Windows Enterprise and Security (ENS) team builds foundational capabilities that keep the Windows client and server operating systems secure and trusted at global scale. ENS spans core Windows security investments such as hardwarebacked security, cryptography, identity and authentication, and enterprisegrade management capabilities—critical to keeping Windows dependable for customers across enterprises and governments. 
As a Senior Software Engineer in ENS India, you will design and ship security and enterprise features that land broadly across the Windows ecosystem. You’ll work closely with partner teams (including engineering counterparts in Redmond) to build secure-by-design, reliable-by-default solutions that meet the bar for global deployment. 
Why this role / impact 
Work on security and enterprise capabilities that protect billions of Windows users and the enterprises that depend on Windows. 
Build foundational security and management features that shape Windows’ trust model and long-term platform resilience. 
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 

Responsibilities
Security & OS Feature Engineering: 
- Design and implement Windows security and enterprise capabilities that ship at scale across client and/or server. 
- Build features across foundational areas such as hardware-backed security, cryptography, identity/authentication, and enterprise management experiences. 
Engineering Excellence (Quality, Reliability, Operability): 
- Produce robust, testable, maintainable code with strong engineering rigor, including diagnostics and operational readiness suitable for global rollout. 
- Partner with security and platform stakeholders to ensure designs align to secure-by-default principles and meet compliance/assurance expectations. 
- Cross-team Collaboration & Delivery 
- Collaborate with ENS partner teams in Redmond and across Windows engineering to deliver shared roadmaps and aligned technical outcomes. 
- Drive end-to-end execution: requirements → design → implementation → validation → deployment, with an ownership mindset. 
- Develop technical talent in the group by coaching, mentoring and showing how it’s done. 
- Be the trailblazer for new technologies and command a industry wide reputation in internal/external forums for a given technology area. 
AIForward Engineering: 
- Leverage AIassisted and agentic engineering workflows to accelerate design, debugging, testing, and documentation—while maintaining strict verification and security quality bars. 
- Establish reusable patterns (e.g., prompt/playbook snippets, validation checklists, automation hooks) that make AI usage repeatable and safe for the team. 
- Improve engineering efficiency by applying AI to: 
- Rootcause analysis and debugging 
- Test generation and validation strategy 
- Automation to reduce recurring toil 

Qualifications
Required Qualifications:
- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 4+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python - OR equivalent experience. 

- Solid experience building and shipping production software in one or more systems languages (e.g., C/C++/C#/Rust) and debugging complex systems. 
- Experience designing and developing features in large-scale, performance-sensitive systems, ideally with Windows / OS / systems depth. 
Other Requirements:
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
 
Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
Preferred Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field plus 8+ years of relevant experience. 
- Experience in one or more: platform security, cryptography, identity/authentication, secure boot/TPM, device security, enterprise policy/management, licensing/entitlement systems. 
- Track record of driving engineering quality: testing strategy, telemetry, reliability, and operational excellence. 
- Comfort partnering across geographies and influencing designs with stakeholders across engineering, security, and program leadership.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
description:
About BrightCHAMPS

BrightChamps is a fast-growing EdTech company building learning experiences that help children develop real-world skills and confidence. We blend pedagogy, technology, and data to create scalable learning programs.

About the Role
We're looking for a hands-on full-stack engineer who has built and operated real-time communication systems at scale. You'll work on WebRTC, video conferencing, and streaming infrastructure, and you'll own the health of those systems end to end. Building the system is only half the job. We expect you to know whether it is actually working, using telemetry, metrics, traces, browser waterfalls, WebRTC statistics, and network behavior. "The deployment succeeded" isn't proof that the system is fine. The data is. You will also work on agentic and AI-powered platforms, using AI as a force multiplier across engineering, debugging, and product problem-solving.

What We're Looking For

Required
- Strong experience building full-stack applications. Minimum 4 years
- Strong experience with React.js, Next.js, Node.js, and MySQL.
- Hands-on experience building or operating WebRTC/video conferencing systems, including
- WebRTC providers or platforms at meaningful scale.
- Strong understanding of WebRTC and real-time media: simulcast, adaptive bitrate, codecs,
- RTP/RTCP, ICE, STUN/TURN, and related concepts.
- Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills.
- Experience with production telemetry, monitoring, and observability.
- Ability to analyze browser waterfalls and network behavior.
- Experience with distributed systems and production infrastructure.
- Strong understanding of AI development tools and workflows.

Strong Plus

- Experience building agentic platforms or AI-powered products.
- Experience with large-scale conferencing platforms or thousands of concurrent real-time
- connections.
- Experience with Amazon IVS, LiveKit, Agora, Twilio, Daily, Vonage, or similar platforms.
- Experience with OpenTelemetry or similar observability tooling.
- Experience building real-time dashboards and monitoring systems.
- Experience with media quality analytics and WebRTC QoS.
- Experience with Kubernetes and AWS.

What You'll Do
1. Work on agentic and AI platforms

- Build applications where AI agents interact with users, tools, APIs, and business systems.
- Understand agent workflows, tool calling, state management, and orchestration.
- Build reliable systems around LLMs and agents, with attention to latency, reliability,
- observability, and cost.
- Evaluate and monitor AI-powered workflows.
- Use AI aggressively as a development multiplier. You should ask "Can AI do this for me?" before
- spending hours on repetitive work by hand.

2. Full-stack engineering

- Frontend: Build with React.js and Next.js, with a solid grasp of browser performance, state
- management, API integration, and modern web architecture. Debug issues at the frontend,
- browser, and network levels.
- Backend: Design and build APIs and backend services in Node.js. Work with asynchronous and
- distributed systems, MySQL and database design, caching, queues, and event-driven
- architecture.
- Infrastructure: Understand cloud infrastructure, containers, deployment, scaling, and
- observability, and debug across application, infrastructure, and network layers.

description:
Acceldata is reimagining the way companies observe their Data! 

Acceldata is the pioneer and leader in data observability, revolutionizing how enterprises manage and observe data by offering comprehensive insights into various key aspects of data, data pipelines and data infrastructure across various environments. Our platform empowers data teams to manage products effectively by ensuring data quality, preventing failures, and controlling costs.

As a Senior Software Engineer

You’ll be responsible for building, scaling and maintaining the core features and capabilities of our Data Observability suite. You’ll work closely with the frontend and product teams to create a reliable and scalable platform.

A day in the life of Senior Software Engineer

- Designing, building and improving the capabilities of some of the key features of the product.
- Investigating software-related complaints and making necessary adjustments to ensure optimal software performance.
- Diving deep into open-source data engines and work on optimising their performance.
- Designing, building and maintaining low-latency APIs.
- Developing services that will be consumed by the frontend and solution engineers.
- Regularly attending team meetings to discuss projects, brainstorm ideas, and put forward solutions to any issues.

- 4-8 years of experience in JVM (Java, Scala, Kotlin)
- Strong data structure, algorithm design, and problem-solving skills.
- Experience with database systems, RDBMS, Mongo, and Elastic Search.
- Experience in cloud technologies
- Knowledge of distributed systems, experience in enterprise software and SQL.

Bonus Points for

- Experience in Spark / Kafka.
- Experience in Data Quality / Data Catalog is preferred.

 We care for our team 

- Mentorship & Growth
- ESOPs
- Medical and Life Insurance
- Paid Maternity & Parental Leave
- Corporate Uber Program
- Learning & Development Support

 Acceldata for All

We promote innovation, commitment, and accountability. Our goal is to cultivate a healthy work environment that fosters a sense of belonging, encourages teamwork, and brings out the best in every individual.

 Why Acceldata? 

Acceldata is redefining data observability for enterprise data systems. Founded by experts who recognized the need for innovative monitoring and management solutions in a cloud-first, AI-driven environment, our platform empowers data teams to effectively manage data products. We address common challenges such as scaling and performance issues, cost overruns, and data quality problems by providing operational visibility, proactive alerts, and monitoring reliability across the various environments. 

Delivered as a SaaS product, Acceldata's solutions have been embraced by global customers, such as HPE, HSBC, Visa, Freddie Mac, Manulife, Workday, Zoominfo, GSK, Oracle, PubMatic, PhonePe (Walmart), Hersheys, Dun & Bradstreet, and many more.
